def hidden_rule_fn(state):
    """
    The world transitions by appending a new nibrel at the end.
    The new value uses shift-merge: left-shift the last element by 1
    (masked to 4 bits), then OR with the parity bit of the second-to-last element.
    
    Rule: new_val = ((state[-1] << 1) & 0xF) | (state[-2] & 1)
    This matches all 12 training observations exactly.
    """
    last = state[-1]
    second = state[-2]
    new_val = ((last << 1) & 0xF) | (second & 1)
    return state + [new_val]
